tool_analysis:
Step Analysis: The recorded steps demonstrate updating an order's status in Magento admin by navigating to a specific order view page, filling out a comment form with status update information, setting visibility options, and submitting the update.

Task Definition: Create a tool that updates the status of a specific Magento order identified by order ID, allowing users to add comments with configurable visibility and notification settings.

Action Plan:
1. Navigate to the specific order view page using the order ID
2. Fill the comment textarea with the provided comment text
3. Select the appropriate status from the dropdown (if available)
4. Check/uncheck the "Notify Customer by Email" checkbox based on user preference
5. Check/uncheck the "Visible on Frontend" checkbox based on user preference
6. Submit the form to update the order status

Variable Identification:
1. order_id - Required - The Magento order ID to update (from URL pattern)
2. comment - Required - The comment text to add to the order status update
3. status - Optional - The order status to set (if dropdown has multiple options)
4. notify_customer - Optional - Whether to notify customer by email (default: false)
5. visible_on_frontend - Optional - Whether comment is visible to customer (default: false)

Step Optimization: The recorded steps show a complete workflow for updating order status. All steps are essential for the core task. The tool should focus only on the order status update functionality, not the filtering/sorting/export controls demonstrated later in the session, as those are separate functionalities for order list management, not order status updates.

Important Notes:
- The status dropdown may only show the current status (e.g., "Pending") if no other status changes are available
- The tool should handle cases where only one status option is available
- The agent is already logged in, so no authentication steps are needed
- The starting URL pattern shows order_id parameter in the URL: http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/sales_order/view/order_id/{order_id}/
name: magento_update_order_status
